description: Verify that Repetition Phase OfferService delay doubles between consecutive emits (SOME/IP-SD §4.2.1)
approach:
[Objective]
The Repetition Phase: after the InitialWait, OfferService is sent at intervals that double — RepBaseDelay, 2×, 4× — until either Repetition count is reached or main phase begins. Doubling is the spec invariant.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT starts service.
2. DUT → Tester: OfferService #1 → #2 → #3.
3. Observation: Δt(#2,#1) ≈ RepBaseDelay; Δt(#3,#2) ≈ 2× RepBaseDelay (with tolerance).

[Pass condition]
Gap doubles within the spec's tolerance band.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_phase<n>_no_offer<n> — offer n missing
• Fail_phase3_gap_out_of_tolerance — gap not 2×

verdicts.Fail_phase1_no_offer1: No first offer within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_offer2: No second offer within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_offer3: No third offer within listen window
verdicts.Fail_phase3_gap_out_of_tolerance: Repetition phase gap not within 2× rep_base_delay tolerance
